newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG new GDRs could be used for merger.
newsitem.headline: BIG new GDRs could be used for merger.

text.p: Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) planned GDRs issue could be used to conclude the bank's merger with Bank Gdanski, planned to take effect by the end of September, BIG's deputy president said on Wednesday.

"An exchange of Gdanski's GDRs for BIG's GDRs is possible," Anna Rapacka told a news conference, adding that the permits of Polish Securities Commission, National Bank of Poland and depositary bank would be necessary to carry out the operation.
BIG plans a new share issue of between 60 and 75 million shares before the merger, part of which could be GDRs, and another share issue of 215,732,000 for an exchange for Gdanski shares.
Gdanski has 19.5 percent of its shares in GDRs.
Shareholders of Gdanski and BIG are expected to decide on their merger in late June. To conclude the merger an exchange of 11 BIG's shares for one Gdanski share will take place.
